<h1><img src="data:image/png;base64," height="186" width="179"></h1><p>&nbsp;<img src="data:image/png;base64,"></p><p>“If you have two quarterbacks you have none.”</p><p>	–&nbsp;Lots of people have said this including Coach Gene Stallings – does anyone know the first to say so?</p><p>Moving on to the Alabama game…Dan Mullen has two quarterbacks to welcome the Crimson Tide to Gainesville this Saturday. But are two heads always better than one? Even when the head coach says <u>this</u> about one of these heads, “He (QB Anthony Richardson) doesn’t always do the right thing, but he does special things.” Really?!? That’s all the love you got for your other QB? Couldn’t you say the same thing about Jeffrey Dahmer/fill in the name of any psychopath here? Not the praise one strives for. </p><p>But Florida Junior Linebacker Brenton Cox is not worried about the upcoming game at all commenting, “We’re ready, of course. The big question is are they ready?” No wonder you’re so cocky Brenton since you have history on your side. Oh…that’s right…Florida has not beaten Alabama in Gainesville since 2006 back when you were in elementary school Brenton! Grow up already! </p><p>All this stupidity and smack talk is getting me fired up! Let’s go watch football! Beat the Gators, Go Kitties and, of course, Roll Tide!</p><p>Enjoy Week 3,</p><p>Jackie</p><p><br></p>
